verdict.rationale: Undermind is driven by natural language. Users state an open-ended research goal, it asks follow-up questions, and they can then brainstorm, iterate on reports and extract details conversationally (docs-4, docs-37, docs-38, docs-39). Its MCP tools also let chat agents create notes, curate folders, star papers and search by plain-language request, for example by typing @Undermind in a chat client (docs-6, docs-7, docs-8, docs-28, docs-21). Community users confirm that natural-language prompts and question refinement work better than keyword fiddling (comm-17, comm-8, comm-5). Missing for 10: no evidence that account, team and alert settings can be managed through natural-language commands.
